name: io.github.exoma-ch/hyrr
title: HYRR
description: Radio-isotope production, activity and dose for charged-particle beams on stacked targets

environmentVariables.name: HYRR_DATA
environmentVariables.description: nucl-parquet data directory. Unset: the matching data release is fetched once into ~/.hyrr/nucl-parquet

environmentVariables.name: HYRR_LIBRARY
environmentVariables.description: Nuclear data library id, e.g. tendl-2023-iso (default) or endfb-8.1
